scraped.scraped_description: Data related to X's Community Notes system. Contribute to travisbrown/birdwatch development by creating an account on GitHub.

name: Community Notes (Birdwatch) Analysis Tool
tagline: Metadata repository and analysis tools for X's Community Notes system, adding user aliases and tweet-author data missing from official snapshots
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
known_funders: Prototype Fund (Open Knowledge Foundation Germany / Federal Ministry of Education and Research BMBF)
dependency_risks: X/Twitter API access and continued public data availability
X policy changes to Community Notes snapshot publication

news_articles.headline: German government funds 'research' project that doxxed Libs of Tik Tok

academic_citations.title: Public Participation in Scientific Research: a Framework for Deliberate Design
Using social media to quantify nature-based tourism and recreation
Reconciliation ecology and the future of species diversity

published_performance_metrics: Approximately 96% of distinct participant IDs resolved to aliases; ~12% of noted tweets not available
documented_limitations: ~12% of tweets that received Community Notes unavailable during compilation
Intentionally contains only metadata, not tweet or note content
failure_modes: X/Twitter restricting access to Community Notes snapshot data
curation_criteria: Metadata only; all data sourced from X's publicly published daily Community Notes snapshots
contributor_governance: open-source community contributions accepted; single maintainer decision authority
controversies: Travis Brown's related projects attracted controversy from right-wing outlets over alleged doxxing; project funded by German government via Prototype Fund
political_bias_allegations: Accused by conservative outlets of targeting right-wing accounts disproportionately in related projects
legal_regulatory_issues: potential privacy concerns regarding alias resolution and user identification
government_partnerships: Prototype Fund (German Federal Ministry of Education and Research)
political_relevance_summary: Addresses challenges in information integrity by serving researchers, journalists, fact-checkers.

movement_building_utility.notes: Technology platform serving civic technology needs.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase facilitates replication and adaptation. Already deployed across multiple jurisdictions (2 countries), demonstrating cross-context adaptability.
